# monotaur_notification_policy (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur notification policy. A policy routes events to notification channels by label, component, monitor and alarm severity, and can repeat an unacknowledged alarm at an interval. Once any policy names a channel, that channel only receives events a policy targeting it matches. Escalation steps are managed separately with `monotaur_notification_escalation_step`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "monotaur_label" "production" {
  text = "env_production"
}

resource "monotaur_notification_channel" "prod_oncall" {
  name        = "#prod-oncall"
  type        = "Webhook"
  event_types = ["com.monotaur.alarm.triggered", "com.monotaur.alarm.cleared"]
  credential  = "https://hooks.example.com/prod-oncall"
}

# Send production alarms of severity Error or above to #prod-oncall, and
# remind the channel every 15 minutes until the alarm is acknowledged.
resource "monotaur_notification_policy" "production" {
  name                    = "Production on-call"
  minimum_severity        = "Error"
  repeat_interval_minutes = 15
  channel_ids             = [monotaur_notification_channel.prod_oncall.id]
  label_ids               = [monotaur_label.production.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The display name of the policy (1 to 200 characters).

### Optional

- `channel_ids` (List of String) IDs of the notification channels notified of matching events and of repeats. Set to `[]` to remove all.
- `component_ids` (List of String) IDs of components to match: one of them is among the event's components. Set to `[]` to remove all.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy matches events. A disabled policy matches nothing but its channels stay routed. Defaults to `true`.
- `label_ids` (List of String) IDs of labels to match: the event's monitor or one of its components carries one of them. Set to `[]` to remove all.
- `minimum_severity` (String) The least severe alarm the policy matches: `Info`, `Warning`, `Error` or `Critical`. Omit to match any severity. Only alarm events have a severity, so setting this excludes every other event.
- `monitor_ids` (List of String) IDs of monitors to match: the event's monitor is one of them. Set to `[]` to remove all.
- `repeat_interval_minutes` (Number) How often, in minutes (1 to 10080), an open and unacknowledged alarm is notified again to the policy's channels. Omit to notify once.

### Read-Only

- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the policy was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the notification policy (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the policy was last updated (assigned by the API).
